notes.text: The extant midrash reads Eliezer son of Rabbi Yose ben Zamra, giving a patronym.
The second witness reads Elazar son of Rabbi Yose ben Zamra in the same parable. Keep the Elazar/Eliezer spelling distinction.
Heilprin proposes reading “in his name.” Both checked midrash passages present a son-of expression. Explicit reports of a similar name elsewhere do not settle this occurrence.
